info.name: EBS BioCrop Backend - Redesigned API Flow
info.description:
Use this collection step by step. Choose a local or deployed baseUrl first. Public requests need no token; customer, seller, and admin requests use separate tokens that are saved after OTP verification or password login. Fill in your real development account emails and read OTPs from your configured delivery channel. Never put passwords, OTPs, reset tokens, or bearer tokens directly in request examples.

The catalog IDs below are current development examples. The product list request refreshes productId and variantId from live results; category roots refresh parentCategoryId. Write workflows create test listings, categories, blog records, and a temporary collection. Use dedicated development accounts. Image upload requires you to attach safe test files in Postman. Run requests in order within each numbered group; do not use Run on the whole collection because OTPs, account setup, uploads, and write steps need user input.

Order requests need an authenticated customer, an active in-stock variant, and a non-empty cart. Order creation currently records AWAITING_PAYMENT; there is no payment-provider flow in this collection. Review APIs are deferred. Cleanup and destructive examples are labeled and placed last.

Choose 1 to 6 safe development test images in the files field in Postman (each file must be 8 MB or smaller). This uploads files to GCS for sellerProductId; do not use actual catalog images for this workflow. Approval requires at least one image. Upload at least two if you want to try both delete examples.

item.description: Protected admin actions. Category examples create uniquely named test records. Product actions target test listing variables.

item.name: 7. Admin blog lifecycle - ROLE_ADMIN

request.description: Creates a uniquely named temporary blog draft with structured text, a category, and a featured image URL so it can pass the current publish checks. It uses a placeholder HTTPS image URL; replace it with an accessible approved image if your validator checks reachability.
Replaces the test blog draft with complete publishable content. Uses the same temporary blog slug and sample image URL.
Schedules the test blog about one hour in the future. Run after updating it; scheduledAt is generated automatically each time.
Soft-deletes the temporary test blog. Run near the end of the blog workflow, after you have completed other blog checks.
Restores the same soft-deleted test blog. The blog is restored as a draft.

item.description: Creates and manages a temporary test blog. Run the steps in order; publish checks require structured content, category, and featured image.

1. Add an available item to cart - ROLE_CUSTOMER

request.description: Adds one available variant from the current public product list to the signed-in test customer cart. Check that variantId is in stock before running. Required immediately before creating an order.

item.name: 2. Create a customer partial-payment order - ROLE_CUSTOMER

request.description: Before running, add an available variant to the customer cart. This request creates an order in AWAITING_PAYMENT; payment processing is not implemented in this API flow. Cancel the unpaid test order afterward to keep the development order list tidy.
Uses the customer order created in this test flow. Order list/detail calls require the same customer account that placed it.

item.name: 13. Create a test order for a customer - ROLE_ADMIN

request.description: Requires customerId saved by customer OTP verification and an available item in that customer’s cart. Uses the admin token.

item.name: 15. Read an order by ID - ROLE_ADMIN

request.description: Use adminOrderId for the order created by the admin test-order request, or orderId for a customer-created test order.

item.name: 16. Customer reads the admin-created order - ROLE_CUSTOMER

request.description: A customer can read only their own order. This uses the customerId account that adminOrderId was created for.

item.name: 17. Customer cancels the admin-created unpaid order - ROLE_CUSTOMER

request.description: Cancels the unpaid admin-created order as its customer. Run only if it is still in a cancellable state.

item.description: Add an available product to the customer cart before each order creation. Seller reads are owner-scoped. Cancel unpaid test orders.

item.name: 9. Admin collection management - ROLE_ADMIN
1. Create a temporary test collection - ROLE_ADMIN

request.description: Creates a uniquely named temporary collection with one subcollection and saves their IDs for later requests.
Returns active collections and their derived product counts.

item.name: 3. Get the current Shop By Crop collection - Public

request.description: Uses the existing live development collection slug shop-by-crop; change collectionSlug only if that collection has been renamed.

item.name: 4. Update the temporary test collection - ROLE_ADMIN

request.description: Updates the temporary collection only. It preserves the subcollection ID returned by create.

item.name: 5. Assign the temporary collection to the test listing - ROLE_ADMIN

request.description: This replaces assigned collection membership, so target only sellerProductId created for this test. It requires that the temporary collection and subcollection already exist.

item.name: 6. Deactivate the temporary test collection - ROLE_ADMIN (run last)

request.description: Deactivates only testCollectionId. Run after the assignment/read checks. This is a soft deactivation, not a permanent delete.

item.description: Creates a temporary collection and assigns it only to the temporary seller listing. Deactivate it last.

item.name: 10. Optional destructive cleanup

request.description: Optional destructive step. Soft-deletes the current customer account. Run only at the end with a dedicated development customer account; this account may no longer be able to log in.
